messages:
Alex T.: quick status check — v2 deprecation plan and owners. I want to lock milestones today: feature-freeze, canary rollout, and final cutover. Can owners confirm blockers and any infra / sdk deps?
Priya N.: I can own the auth shim PR and the SDK compatibility shim. PR #432 is in review, reviewers requested a small test fix. ETA Thu.
Chris M.: proxy header change (x-rw-client) will be behind a feature flag on the gateway. eng-infra needs a 48h window to validate. I can schedule the window but need QA signoff.
Jamie L.: SDK release is blocked on the codegen bump — there is a breaking param rename (removed `n` optional). I have a draft changelog and a migration snippet ready. Will cut release once Priya's shim lands.
Samir K.: quick ask — do we have a customer impact list? recommend we check top 10 API keys before hard cut. Some partners still on old endpoint.
Alex T.: we do have metrics: ~8% of production traffic still hitting v1. Proposal: 6-week gradual deprecation: 2w notice, 2w canary, 2w cutover. Canary to 5% traffic, then 25%, then 100% fallback. Thoughts?
Priya N.: sounds reasonable. One note: the shim will add ~20ms avg latency; add to the SLA considerations.
Chris M.: infra can support the 5% -> 25% ramp. Need list of routes to include in canary (suggest: /generate, /chat/stream, /embeddings).
Jamie L.: SDK will default to new endpoint after release with opt-out env var. I will include migration guide and example snippet:
```bash
# opt-in to new v2 endpoint
export RW_API_BASE=https://api.redwood.example/v2
# fallback for testing
export RW_LEGACY_FALLBACK=true
```
Alex T.: owners: can everyone confirm by EOD that they can meet the 6-week plan? If any objections ping me. Also need eng-platform to create the canary route config (who can own?)
Samir K.: I can coordinate customer notices with growth. Please drop a short list of affected keys once you have it.
Priya N.: confirmed on shim ETA Thu. I can also own the canary toggle gate for SDKs.
Chris M.: I'll own the infra rollout and schedule the 48h validation window.
Jamie L.: SDK release blocked -> will be done within 48h of shim merge. I'll post the release branch here.
Alex T.: outstanding deps: (1) shim PR #432, (2) gateway flag + canary routes, (3) codegen bump + SDK release, (4) partner opt-in notices. Can we put these into a small checklist and update the migration board?
ci-bot: deploy pipeline for `canary-config` succeeded (build 4520) :white_check_mark:
Alex T.: thanks — marking action items. If anyone hits a blocker before EOD, call it out here. Otherwise I'll update the migration board and set the tentative start-of-notice date to next Tue. :calendar:
